notes: M1 is frontend-only: mock data, no backend, no real auth (auth is M2).
Every screen fetches through getRepositories(); swapping mock->API needs no screen changes.
Scope guardrails (PRD §7/§9): subscriptions read-only, Zoom static links, no payment processing, no Reports/Q&A/Reschedule/Request-Homework.
Interactive prototype behaviours (form submits, mark-read, feedback, filters) hold state locally only — they are wired to real endpoints in M2–M4.
